According to a study published in Environmental Research Letters by MIT researchers, the massive electricity demands of artificial intelligence data centers create widespread air pollution far beyond their physical locations. The team estimates that additional emissions from grid power plants in 2023 resulted in approximately 650 premature deaths across the United States. 

By building a **sophisticated modeling framework**, the researchers tracked how power grid demands ripple across the country, showing that fossil fuel generators—often natural gas and coal plants—ramp up to meet 24/7 computing needs. Due to atmospheric conditions and regional power generation mixes, Midwestern states like Iowa, Kansas, and South Dakota suffered higher per capita premature mortality rates than Virginia and Texas, where most data centers are actually located. 

The findings emphasize that policymakers and tech companies must consider **broader public health impacts** and regional atmospheric interactions when choosing where to site data centers and how to supply them with clean energy.

zh.title: 研究发现AI数据中心会跨区域污染空气并引发健康风险
zh.summary: 据MIT Climate发布的信息：麻省理工学院的一项新研究表明，美国数据中心在2023年的用电需求导致全国约有 **650人过早死亡**。有趣的是，受害最严重的往往是远离弗吉尼亚和得克萨斯等数据中心聚集地的中西部州，这暴露出一种 **意料之外的污染错位** 现象。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Climate发布的信息：

根据麻省理工学院研究人员发表在《环境研究快报》上的一项研究，人工智能数据中心的巨额用电需求引发了远超其物理位置的广泛空气污染。研究团队估算，2023年电网发电厂因满足数据中心电力需求而产生的额外排放，导致全美约有650人过早死亡。

通过构建一个 **复杂的建模框架**，研究人员追踪了电网电力需求在全国范围内的传导过程，发现为了满足全天候的计算需求，化石燃料发电机组（通常是天然气和燃煤电厂）不得不加大马力。由于大气条件和区域发电结构的不同，艾奥瓦州、堪萨斯州和南达科他州等中西部州的人均过早死亡率，反而高于数据中心主要集中的弗吉尼亚州和得克萨斯州。

这些研究结果强调，政策制定者和科技公司在选择数据中心选址以及为其提供电力供应时，必须将 **更广泛的公共健康影响** 和区域大气反应纳入考量。

en.title: John Deere Acquires Orchard Robotics to Boost AI Farming Tech
en.summary: John Deere has acquired **Orchard Robotics**, an AI-powered crop intelligence startup founded in 2022. The move aims to integrate Orchard's plant-by-plant camera vision with Deere's heavy machinery, helping farmers easily turn field data into **actionable results** without needing to be data experts.
en.full_summary:
Founded in 2022, Orchard Robotics developed an AI-powered camera system that mounts onto farm vehicles, capturing millions of images to measure fruit counts, size, health, and disease status. The data is processed locally using onboard NVIDIA hardware, bypassing poor farm internet connectivity, and feeds into a platform called FruitScope.

Industry experts note the deal highlights the **growing value of actionable farm data**, with Orchard providing Deere the plant-level vision for orchards and vineyards that previous acquisitions gave it for row crops. Moving forward, the combined technology will enable automated processes like variable-rate spraying, which optimizes chemical use and significantly **reduces labor costs** for farmers.

zh.title: 农机巨头约翰迪尔收购 AI 农业初创公司 Orchard Robotics
zh.summary: 农机巨头约翰迪尔收购了成立于 2022 年的 AI 农业初创公司 **Orchard Robotics**。此举旨在将该公司的单株作物视觉技术与迪尔的大型农机相结合，帮助农户把田间数据直接转化为**实际收益**，而无需自己去当数据分析专家。
zh.full_summary:
Orchard Robotics 成立于 2022 年，开发了一套可安装在农用车辆上的 AI 摄像头系统，能通过拍摄大量照片来测量果实数量、大小、健康状况和病虫害。由于农场网络通常较差，该系统使用车上的英伟达硬件进行本地处理，并将结果汇入其 FruitScope 平台。

行业专家认为，这笔交易凸显了**实用农田数据的价值**正在不断攀升，Orchard 为约翰迪尔补齐了在果园和葡萄园里的单株作物视觉技术。未来，双方的技术结合将实现精准喷洒等自动化操作，从而优化农药使用并大幅**降低人工成本**。

en.title: AI is great at coding, but still struggles with tasks requiring human judgment
en.summary: A new report from nonprofit METR shows that while AI capabilities continue to improve rapidly on verifiable tasks like coding, they still **fall short** when tackling open-ended problems that require human judgment. Experts view this inclusion of subjective tasks as a **welcome change**, though predicting long-term progress in these complex areas remains difficult.
en.full_summary:
## The Limits of Verifiable Tasks
According to METR, AI systems have excelled at coding and math because they are verifiable domains where solutions can be automatically checked, allowing reinforcement learning to strengthen successful neural pathways. However, applying this technique to open-ended tasks like choosing research directions is **much harder**.

## Testing Judgment
To address this, METR updated its evaluation plot to include fuzzier tasks, such as designing AI evaluations and scoring philosophical arguments. On these tasks, models consistently lagged behind human performance. Even though advanced models excel at software engineering, none of their AI-designed evaluations were deemed useful by METR employees, highlighting a **current performance gap** in judgment-heavy areas.

## Future Outlook
While some experts like UC Berkeley's Sayash Kapoor view the inclusion of open-ended tasks as crucial for understanding AI research and development automation, others debate whether models trained on verifiable tasks will eventually master judgment. METR researchers note that quantifying such tasks remains difficult, leaving the **future trajectory** of these capabilities uncertain.

zh.title: AI写代码虽然很溜，但遇到需要人类判断的活儿还是抓瞎
zh.summary: 非营利组织METR的一份新报告显示，虽然AI在写代码等可验证任务上的能力飞速提升，但在处理需要人类判断的开放式问题时依然**力不从心**。专家们认为引入这类主观任务是一个**积极的改变**，尽管要预测这些复杂领域的长期进展仍然非常困难。
zh.full_summary:
## 可验证任务的局限性
据METR称，AI系统之所以在编程和数学方面表现出色，是因为这些是可以通过自动化检查验证的领域，这使得强化学习能够巩固成功的神经路径。然而，将这种技术应用到诸如选择研究方向等开放式任务上则**难得多**。

## 考验判断力
为了解决这个问题，METR更新了其评估图表，纳入了更模糊的任务，例如设计AI评估方案和给哲学论点打分。在这些任务中，模型普遍落后于人类表现。尽管先进模型擅长软件工程，但没有一个AI设计的评估方案被METR员工认为有用，这凸显了在重判断力领域的**当前性能差距**。

## 未来展望
虽然加州大学伯克利分校的Sayash Kapoor等专家认为，引入开放式任务对于理解AI研发自动化至关重要，但另一些人则争论在可验证任务上训练的模型最终是否能掌握判断力。METR的研究人员指出，量化这类任务仍然很困难，这使得这些能力的**未来发展轨迹**充满不确定性。

en.title: Revolution Medicines reports positive early survival data for pancreatic cancer drug Rasonque
en.summary: Revolution Medicines shared early data showing that its pancreatic cancer drug Rasonque, when combined with chemotherapy, achieved a **60.7% response rate** in initial treatment. Financial analysts at Truist Securities believe these strong results could **push future sales** beyond current projections, strengthening the drug's position as a new standard treatment.
en.full_summary:
## Clinical Results and Trial Details
According to Revolution Medicines, data from 61 patients in the ongoing Phase 1/2 RMC-GI-102 open-label trial presented at a recent medical meeting showed that Rasonque combined with two types of chemotherapy achieved an **objective response rate of 60.7%** in first-line pancreatic cancer patients. The trial reported a median progression-free survival of 12.8 months, outperforming analyst expectations, while overall survival reached 76.6% at the 12-month mark.

## Market Impact and Competition
Following these findings, Truist Securities noted that the drug's profile sets a high efficacy bar and could boost Revolution Medicines beyond its currently estimated **$14.5 billion in peak sales**. Meanwhile, the company faces patent litigation and upcoming clinical readouts from competitors like Erasca, which is developing its own targeted therapies in the space.

zh.title: Revolution Medicines公布胰腺癌新药Rasonque的早期积极生存数据
zh.summary: Revolution Medicines公布的早期数据显示，其胰腺癌新药Rasonque在联合化疗用于一线治疗时，取得了**60.7%的反应率**。Truist Securities的金融分析师认为，这些强劲的成果有望**推动未来销售额**超越目前的预期，进一步巩固该药物作为新标准疗法的地位。
zh.full_summary:
## 临床结果与试验细节
据Revolution Medicines称，在近期医学会议上公布的正在进行的1/2期RMC-GI-102开放标签试验中，61名患者的数据显示，Rasonque联合两种化疗药物在一线胰腺癌患者中实现了**60.7%的客观反应率**。该试验的中位无进展生存期达到12.8个月，超出了分析师的预期，而12个月时的总生存率达到了76.6%。

## 市场影响与竞争格局
基于这些发现，Truist Securities指出，该药物的疗效表现设立了高标准，并有望**推动未来销售峰值**超越目前估计的14.5亿美元。与此同时，该公司还面临着来自竞争对手Erasca的专利诉讼以及即将发布的临床数据，后者也在开发针对该领域的靶向疗法。

en.title: SK hynix Showcases Memory-Centric AI Vision at Supercomputing 2026
en.summary: According to SK hynix Newsroom: SK hynix presented its next-generation memory technologies at Supercomputing 2026, highlighting how **memory-centric systems** and CXL-based pooled memory can solve AI infrastructure bottlenecks. The company demonstrated live solutions including MARS architecture and computational DRAM to **improve data processing efficiency** for large language models.
en.full_summary:
According to SK hynix Newsroom:

At Supercomputing 2026 in Chicago, SK hynix introduced its technology vision focused on reshaping the AI ecosystem around advanced memory solutions. The company showcased its Memory-centric AI Rack System (MARS) alongside three key CXL-based demonstrations, including rack-level KV cache sharing, computational memory pools for AI agents, and token-sharing across CPU servers to reduce GPU idle time.

Additionally, SK hynix presented advanced hardware zones featuring KV Cache Offloading over CXL, Compute-using-DRAM, and Custom HBM Array. Alongside these conceptual designs, the company displayed its core product portfolio for AI infrastructure, featuring next-generation HBM4 and HBM4E, high-capacity 256GB 3DS DDR5 RDIMM modules, and liquid-cooling-supported eSSDs.

zh.title: SK海力士在2026超级计算大会上展示以内存为核心的AI技术愿景
zh.summary: 据SK hynix Newsroom发布的信息：SK海力士在2026超级计算大会上展示了其下一代内存技术，重点介绍了如何通过**以内存为中心的系统**和CXL内存池来解决AI基础设施的性能瓶颈。该公司通过现场演示MARS架构和计算型内存等方案，致力于**提升大模型的处理效率**。
zh.full_summary:
据SK hynix Newsroom发布的信息：

在芝加哥举行的2026超级计算大会上，SK海力士介绍了其旨在围绕先进内存重塑AI生态的技术愿景。该公司展示了内存中心化AI机架系统（MARS）以及三项基于CXL的关键技术演示，包括机架级KV缓存共享、用于AI代理的计算内存池，以及跨CPU服务器的词元共享以减少GPU空置时间。

此外，SK海力士还设立了多个硬件展示区，重点呈现了CXL缓存卸载、计算型DRAM以及定制化HBM阵列等技术。除了这些前沿概念设计，该公司还展出了面向AI基础设施的核心产品组合，包括下一代HBM4与HBM4E、大容量256GB 3DS DDR5 RDIMM内存条，以及支持液冷的固态硬盘。

en.title: Amazon Bedrock now lets AI agents buy software and APIs directly through AWS bills
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Amazon is expanding its Bedrock AgentCore payments feature to support **AWS Marketplace**, allowing AI agents to autonomously buy tools and pay in USD without needing crypto wallets or API keys. Developers can set strict **spending limits** and monitor all purchases through standard AWS billing and auditing tools.
en.full_summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Amazon reports that its Bedrock AgentCore payments now integrate with AWS Marketplace, enabling AI agents to discover, purchase, and use x402-enabled software, APIs, and data directly charged to the developer's AWS account. According to AWS, when an agent encounters a payment requirement, it forwards the signed quote to AgentCore payments, which verifies session budgets before issuing a payment token. Developers maintain control by configuring spending caps, approved seller lists, and separate IAM roles for sessions and payments. AWS states that transactions are fully auditable through CloudTrail and Cost Explorer, and early partners like Tavily are already offering integrated live search tools for autonomous agentic commerce.

zh.title: 亚马逊 Bedrock 允许 AI 专家直接通过 AWS 账单自主购买软件和 API
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：亚马逊正在扩展其 Bedrock AgentCore 支付功能以支持 **AWS Marketplace**，允许 AI 专家自主购买工具并使用美元支付，无需加密钱包或 API 密钥。开发人员可以设置严格的**消费限额**，并通过标准的 AWS 账单和审计工具监控所有购买行为。
zh.full_summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：亚马逊报告称，其 Bedrock AgentCore 支付功能现已与 AWS Marketplace 集成，使 AI 专家能够发现、购买和使用支持 x402 协议的软件、API 和数据，费用直接记入开发者的 AWS 账户。据亚马逊称，当 AI 专家遇到付款需求时，它会将签名报价转发给 AgentCore 支付系统，该系统在发放支付令牌前会核对会话预算。开发者可以通过配置消费上限、获批卖家名单以及分离开设的会话和支付角色来保持控制权。亚马逊表示，所有交易均可通过 CloudTrail 和 Cost Explorer 进行全面审计，诸如 Tavily 等早期合作伙伴已开始提供用于自主智能体商业的集成实时搜索工具。

en.title: Novartis CEO says AI will speed up drug development, but solving biology will take a decade
en.summary: Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan states that **AI is already cutting** clinical trial timelines and paperwork. However, he warns that solving complex **biological latency** will be a long journey, pushing back against tech optimists who claim major diseases will disappear in a decade.
en.full_summary:
Speaking at an investor event, Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan outlined the drugmaker's goal to use AI to **improve clinical success rates** from 8% to 12% while slashing four years off the standard 12-year R&D cycle. Narasimhan categorized drug development bottlenecks into information, operational, and biological latency. Novartis is already seeing major gains in the first two areas, with AI assisting 90% of development content and cutting statistical programming time dramatically. 

However, Narasimhan and Novartis biomedical research president Fiona Marshall argued that **biological latency remains the hardest hurdle**. While AI excels at molecular design, translating predictions into human biology requires navigating complex systems that current models cannot fully simulate on computers alone. This perspective echoes pushback from other pharma leaders against tech sector claims that AI will eliminate major diseases in under a decade, emphasizing that steady, incremental progress and wet-lab validation are still essential.

zh.title: 诺华CEO：AI能加速药物研发，但彻底搞懂人体生物学还得十年
zh.summary: 诺华CEO瓦斯·纳 Narasimhan 表示，**人工智能已经显著缩短**了临床试验和文件的处理时间。不过他同时提醒，彻底攻克复杂的**生物学滞后**将是一个漫长的过程，这也反驳了科技界乐观主义者关于重大疾病十年内会消失的预测。
zh.full_summary:
在一次投资者活动中，诺华公司CEO瓦斯·纳 Narasimhan 介绍了公司的目标，即利用人工智能将药物研发的**临床成功率提升**从8%提高到12%，并将标准的12年研发周期缩短四年。纳 Narasimhan 将药物开发的瓶颈分为信息滞后、运营滞后和生物学滞后。诺华目前在前两个领域已取得显著进展，AI 辅助了90%的开发内容，并大幅缩短了统计编程时间。

不过，纳 Narasimhan 与诺华生物医学研究所所长 Fiona Marshall 均表示，**生物学滞后依然是最难啃的硬骨头**。尽管 AI 擅长分子设计，但要将预测结果转化为人体生物学应用，仍需应对复杂的人体系统，目前的模型还无法纯粹依靠计算机完全模拟。这一观点呼应了其他医药巨头对科技界“十年内消灭重大疾病”言论的质疑，强调稳步的渐进式进展和实验室验证依然不可或缺。

en.title: Why Microsoft, the FAA, and Banks All Broke at the Same Time
en.summary: Microsoft, the FAA, Chase, and Apple all suffered major outages within a single week, sparking widespread speculation about cyberattacks. WIRED editors explain that while officials confirmed no cyberattacks occurred, the clustered failures stem from routine updates colliding and companies aggressively patching vulnerabilities using advanced AI tools.
en.full_summary:
In a chaotic week for technology, major systems including Microsoft, the FAA, JPMorgan Chase, United Airlines, the NSA, and Apple experienced significant outages. Although U.S. officials, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, confirmed that the incidents were not cyberattacks, the timing caused widespread panic and led many to suspect hackers or artificial intelligence.

WIRED editors break down the mundane root causes behind the chaos, noting that Microsoft's issue stemmed from a delayed software fix, while the FAA's communication blackout was tied to outdated fiber equipment updates pushed at an inopportune time. Furthermore, experts discuss how companies are increasingly deploying advanced AI cybersecurity tools like Anthropic's Mythos to patch complex bugs, which paradoxically increases the risk of cascading system failures when multiple patches are rushed simultaneously.

zh.title: 微软、FAA和银行集体崩溃是怎么回事
zh.summary: 微软、美国联邦航空管理局、大通银行和苹果公司在一周内接连发生重大故障，引发了外界对网络攻击的猜测。编辑们解释说，虽然官方确认并非网络攻击，但这些密集的故障其实是由于例行更新撞车，以及企业利用先进AI工具激进修补漏洞引起的。
zh.full_summary:
在科技界混乱的一周里，包括微软、美国联邦航空管理局、摩根大通、美联航、国安局和苹果在内的主要系统相继发生重大故障。尽管包括国务卿马可·鲁比奥在内的美国官方证实这些事件并非网络攻击，但密集的发生时间还是引发了恐慌，让许多人怀疑是黑客或人工智能搞的鬼。

WIRED编辑们剖析了混乱背后的实际原因，指出微软的问题源于一个延迟生效的软件修复，而联邦航空管理局的通信中断则与在不合时宜时推送更新的老旧光纤设备有关。此外，专家们讨论了企业如何越来越多地部署Anthropic的Mythos等先进AI网络安全工具来修补复杂漏洞，这种做法虽然积极，但当多个补丁同时推送时，反而增加了引发连锁系统崩溃的风险。

en.title: Google Signs 50-MW Superhot Geothermal PPA with Quaise Energy
en.summary: Google has signed an agreement with Quaise Energy to purchase **50 MW of electricity** from an Oregon geothermal project, with power expected to supply its data centers **as early as 2030**. This deal highlights the tech industry's growing push for clean, reliable energy to fuel surging data center demands through **next-generation geothermal** technology.
en.full_summary:
According to companies' announcements, Google has agreed to buy 50 MW of electricity from Project Obsidian, a geothermal power project developed by Quaise Energy near Newberry Volcano in central Oregon, valued at **more than $500 million**. The energy will support Google's data center operations in The Dalles, Oregon.

The project will be built in two stages. The initial phase will use conventional drilling, while a subsequent phase will deploy Quaise's millimeter-wave drilling technology to **reach depths of up to 65,000 feet**. At these extreme depths, rock temperatures exceed 932 degrees Fahrenheit, allowing superhot geothermal wells to produce up to 10 times more power per well than conventional sources.

This PPA is part of Google's broader strategy to secure firm, carbon-free electricity, complementing previous investments in advanced nuclear and long-duration storage as the tech sector grapples with **baseload power scarcity** driven by expanding AI data centers.

zh.title: 谷歌与 Quaise Energy 签署 50 兆瓦超高温地热购电协议
zh.summary: 谷歌已与地热初创企业 Quaise Energy 签署协议，将从其位于俄勒冈州的项目购买 **50 兆瓦电力**，预计最早 **2030年** 开始供电。这笔交易凸显了科技行业为满足日益暴涨的数据中心用电需求，正大力押注 **下一代地热** 等清洁且稳定的新型能源。
zh.full_summary:
根据双方公布的信息，谷歌已同意从 Quaise Energy 在俄勒冈州纽berry火山附近开发的黑曜石项目（Project Obsidian）购买 50 兆瓦电力，该协议**价值超过 5.0亿美元**。这笔电力将用于支持谷歌在俄勒冈州达尔斯的数据中心运营。

该项目计划分两阶段建设。第一阶段采用常规钻探技术，随后的阶段则计划部署 Quaise 的毫米波钻探技术，将钻井深度推进**高达 65,000 英尺**。在如此极端的深度下，岩石温度可超过 932 华氏度，使超高温地热井的单井发电量比传统地热高出最多 10 倍。

这份购电协议是谷歌确保全天候无碳电力战略的一部分。随着人工智能数据中心带来巨大的用电需求，科技巨头正面临**基荷电力短缺**的挑战，这也促使它们不断加大对下一代地热、先进核能和储能技术的投资。

en.title: Scientists map every single cell in an adult vertebrate for the first time
en.summary: According to MIT Neuroscience: Researchers at MIT, the Whitehead Institute, and Charité have created the **first whole-body single-cell atlas** of an adult vertebrate using a tiny, transparent fish called *Danionella cerebrum*. Published in *Science*, the study profiles over 600,000 cells, offering a **molecular reference** for gene activity across the entire animal and providing a valuable **baseline for studying regeneration** and aging.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Neuroscience:

A team of researchers from MIT, the Whitehead Institute, and Charité–Universitätsmedizin Berlin has successfully mapped the cell types and gene activity of an entire adult vertebrate. Because profiling larger animals comprehensively is technically demanding and expensive, the team turned to *Danionella cerebrum*, a tiny, transparent fish barely one centimeter long that is closely related to zebrafish.

In a study published in *Science*, the researchers used **single-cell RNA sequencing** and spatial mapping methods to analyze more than 600,000 cells from across the fish's brain, spinal cord, eyes, internal organs, and fins. This comprehensive approach allowed them to capture rare cell populations and observe large-scale patterns, such as how neurons from the same brain region share similar gene activity regardless of the neurotransmitters they use.

The atlas also revealed that adult cells, such as connective-tissue fibroblasts, retain a **molecular memory** of their developmental positions in the body. Furthermore, the team used the map as a reference to track how the fish regenerates missing neurons in the forebrain after injury. The complete atlas has been made publicly available through an interactive online resource called DigiFish.

zh.title: 科学家首次绘制出成年脊椎动物的全身单细胞图谱
zh.summary: 据MIT Neuroscience发布的信息：麻省理工学院、怀特黑德研究所和柏林夏里特医学院的研究人员利用一种微小透明的鱼类 *Danionella cerebrum*，绘制出了**首个成年脊椎动物的全身单细胞图谱**。这项发表在《科学》杂志上的研究分析了超过 60万个细胞，为**全动物基因活性**提供了分子参考，也为**研究再生与衰老**奠定了基础。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Neuroscience发布的信息：

来自麻省理工学院、怀特黑德研究所和柏林夏里特医学院的研究团队成功绘制出了成年脊椎动物的细胞类型与基因活性全景图。由于全面分析较大动物的细胞多样性既困难又昂贵，研究人员选择了 *Danionella cerebrum*，这是一种体长仅一厘米、与斑马鱼亲缘关系很近的微小透明鱼类。

在发表于《科学》杂志的研究中，科学家运用**单细胞RNA测序**与空间定位技术，分析了该鱼脑部、脊髓、眼睛、内脏及鳍等部位的超过 60万个细胞。这种全面方法使他们能够捕获到稀有细胞群，并观察到宏观规律，例如同一脑区的神经元无论使用何种神经递质，其基因活性模式都更为相似。

图谱还显示，成年细胞（如结缔组织成纤维细胞）在体内保留了与其发育位置相关的**分子记忆**。此外，研究团队还利用该图谱作为参考，追踪了鱼类在受到损伤后前脑神经元的再生过程。目前，该完整图谱已通过名为 DigiFish 的在线互动资源向公众开放。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker AI Now Supports Full Fine-Tuning Without Infrastructure Management
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Amazon SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization now supports Full Fine-Tuning, allowing businesses to adapt large language models to complex domains without managing underlying GPU infrastructure. **Experiments demonstrate that FFT** outperforms parameter-efficient methods like LoRA on large, high-quality datasets by capturing complex patterns and overcoming **low-rank limitations**.
en.full_summary:
According to AWS Machine Learning:

Amazon SageMaker AI has updated its Serverless Model Customization service to support Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) alongside existing parameter-efficient methods like LoRA. While LoRA freezes pre-trained weights and injects small replacement matrices, its low-rank nature can hit an accuracy plateau on complex tasks. In contrast, **FFT updates all model parameters** simultaneously, leveraging the full representational capacity of the network to achieve stronger convergence and better layer activation alignment.

To evaluate these methods, tests were conducted using a Qwen3-4B base model trained on 110,000 coding instruction pairs. Results showed that as training data scales beyond 100,000 examples, **FFT achieves superior accuracy** on semantic correctness and surface-level text similarity metrics compared to LoRA. However, FFT also carries a higher risk of catastrophic forgetting, requiring careful tuning of learning rates and epoch counts to preserve general knowledge.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker AI 现已支持全参数微调，无需手动管理基础设施
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：亚马逊 SageMaker AI 无服务模型定制现已支持全参数微调（FFT），让企业能够在无需管理底层 GPU 基础设施的情况下，将大语言模型深度适配到特定领域。**实验表明**，在面对大规模高质量数据集时，FFT 能够突破**低秩限制**，捕捉复杂的领域知识，展现出比 LoRA 更强的性能优势。
zh.full_summary:
据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：

亚马逊 SageMaker AI 的无服务模型定制服务迎来了重大更新，在原本支持的 LoRA 等高效微调方法之外，正式加入了对全参数微调（FFT）的支持。传统的 LoRA 方法通过冻结预训练权重并注入小型矩阵来减少参数，但在处理复杂任务时容易遇到准确率瓶颈。相比之下，**FFT 会同时更新所有模型参数**，利用网络的完整表征能力，实现更强的模型收敛性。

为了对比效果，AWS 团队使用 Qwen3-4B 基础模型和 11 万条代码指令数据集进行了测试。实验显示，当训练数据超过 10 万条时，**FFT 在语义正确性**和文本相似度指标上明显优于 LoRA。不过，FFT 也带来了更严重的灾难性遗忘风险，因此需要仔细调整学习率和训练轮数，以平衡领域适应与通用知识的保留。

en.title: What industrial drone deployments reveal about real-world autonomy challenges
en.summary: Deploying autonomous drones in industrial facilities exposes real-world challenges where subsystems like navigation, obstacle detection, and flight control interact unpredictably. ZenaDrone contributor Jonathan Metzelaar explains that metal structures, signal blockages, and wind gusts create simultaneous disturbances that lab tests rarely capture. Reliable industrial autonomy requires understanding how uncertainties propagate across the entire system rather than relying on isolated component performance.
en.full_summary:
Industrial facilities present complex environments that severely test autonomous drone navigation. GNSS signals can be blocked or distorted by metallic structures, while repetitive pipes and reflective surfaces confuse visual and lidar sensors. Furthermore, wind gusts near buildings introduce aerodynamic disturbances that challenge flight controllers.

ZenaDrone contributor Jonathan Metzelaar notes that autonomy performance depends heavily on the interactions between subsystems whose assumptions are rarely independent. Localization errors can corrupt obstacle coordinates, and processing latency directly translates into physical braking distance, meaning an obstacle avoidance system must be judged on end-to-end timing rather than detection range alone. Additionally, successfully flying a route does not guarantee that collected inspection data, such as thermal imagery or photogrammetry, will be accurate or repeatable.

To ensure safe and reliable deployments, engineering teams must move beyond isolated subsystem tests and evaluate their systems under combined failure scenarios. This includes defining measurable acceptance criteria for localization, latency, and failure recovery, while maintaining clear operational boundaries and supervisory human oversight.

zh.title: 工业无人机实地部署揭示的真实自主飞行挑战
zh.summary: 在工业场地上部署自主无人机，会暴露出实验室里很难遇到的真实挑战，比如导航、避障和飞控等子系统会产生意料之外的连锁反应。ZenaDrone 的撰稿人 Jonathan Metzelaar 指出，金属建筑、信号遮挡和阵风会同时干扰无人机，单一组件表现好不代表整体系统就安全。要实现可靠的工业自主飞行，工程师必须弄清楚误差是如何在整个系统里蔓延的，而不是只盯着单个零件的性能。
zh.full_summary:
工业环境充满了各种复杂因素，对自主无人机的导航能力构成了严峻考验。金属建筑会阻挡或干扰卫星定位信号，而密集的管道和反光表面又会让视觉和激光雷达传感器分不清方向。此外，建筑物附近的阵风会产生复杂的空气动力干扰，给飞行控制器带来麻烦。

ZenaDrone 撰稿人 Jonathan Metzelaar 指出，无人机的自主飞行表现取决于各个子系统之间的相互影响，而这些子系统往往无法彼此独立。定位错误可能会导致避障坐标出现偏差，处理延迟也会直接转化为实际的刹车距离，这意味着评估避障系统不能只看探测距离，还得看整体的反应时间。此外，顺利飞完整条路线并不代表收集到的巡检数据（如热成像或摄影测量）就一定准确或可重复。

为了确保部署安全可靠，工程团队不能只在实验室里测试单个组件，必须在多种故障交织的场景下进行综合评估。这包括为定位、延迟和故障恢复制定可量化的验收标准，同时划定明确的操作边界并保留人类监督的介入机制。

en.title: Soft robotic suit helps older adults stand up and walk more easily
en.summary: Researchers at the Technical University of Munich have developed a **soft, lightweight exosuit** that uses machine learning and artificial tendons to help older adults stand up and walk. In a study of ten older participants, the suit helped them complete **sit-and-stand cycles faster** and reduced walking energy costs, while users still felt in full control of their movements.
en.full_summary:
## How the exosuit works
Developed by researchers at the Technical University of Munich, the exosuit functions like a wearable system with thigh straps, a waist belt, and artificial tendons connected to a backpack-like motor unit. **Sensors on the thighs** track leg movements in real time, and a machine learning algorithm triggers the motor to pull on the tendons, providing hip support exactly when the user stands up or walks.

## Study results and user feedback
In tests involving ten older adults aged 69 to 85, the suit improved mobility significantly. Participants completed **up to four additional sit-and-stand cycles** in one minute, and their average walking metabolic cost dropped by 14%. According to researcher Dr. Xiaohui Zhang, users also reported a high sense of personal agency, feeling that the suit acted like a regular piece of clothing rather than an intrusive machine.

zh.title: 软体机器人外骨骼帮老年人更轻松地站起来和走路
zh.summary: 慕尼黑工业大学的研究人员开发了一款**轻便的软体外骨骼服装**，利用机器学习和人造肌腱来帮助老年人站立和行走。在一项针对十名老年参与者的研究中，这款服装帮助他们**更快地完成起坐循环**并减少了走路时的体力消耗，同时使用者依然觉得完全能自主控制自己的动作。
zh.full_summary:
## 外骨骼是如何工作的
由慕尼黑工业大学研究人员开发的这款外骨骼穿起来就像一件衣服，配有大腿带、腰带以及连接在背包式电机单元上的**人造肌腱**。大腿上的传感器会实时追踪腿部动作，机器学习算法则会在用户站立或行走时精确触发电机拉动肌腱，提供髋部支撑。

## 研究结果与用户反馈
在涉及十名 69 岁至 85 岁老年人的测试中，这款服装显著改善了他们的行动能力。参与者在一分钟内**多完成了最多四次起坐循环**，且步行平均代谢消耗降低了 14%。据研究员 Xiaohui Zhang 称，用户还报告了极高的自主掌控感，感觉这套设备穿在身上就像普通衣服一样自然。

en.title: Biopharma Executives Gather for London Life Sciences Week Amid Strong M&A and China Policy Clouds
en.summary: At London Life Sciences Week, biopharma executives and investors reported a **very healthy sector** driven by major multibillion-dollar acquisitions and record venture funds. However, industry players warned that looming **U.S. restrictions** on investments in China and Europe's persistent lack of a local Nasdaq equivalent continue to shape global strategic planning.
en.full_summary:
During London Life Sciences Week, heavy dealmaking stole the spotlight as pharmaceutical giants like Johnson & Johnson and Eli Lilly announced massive acquisitions, including a $2.2 billion deal by J&J and multi-billion-dollar oncology and fibrosis pacts by Lilly. Legal and financial experts from Baker McKenzie, Sofinnova Partners, and Forbion noted that **M&A activity** is expected to remain robust, bolstered by record-breaking European venture capital funds such as Sofinnova’s $815 million raise and Forbion’s 2.3 billion euro fund.

Despite the optimistic outlook, significant headwinds remain. Investors pointed out that Europe still lacks a **local equivalent to Nasdaq**, forcing growing biotechs to look across the Atlantic for major public listings. Furthermore, the rapid rise of China's automated clinical trial infrastructure has become a central topic of discussion, with U.S. investors rushing to lock in deals ahead of potential regulatory clampdowns by the U.S. Treasury regarding outbound investments in pharmaceutical compounds.

zh.title: 生物医药行业齐聚伦敦生命科学周，并购交易火热但笼罩中国政策阴云
zh.summary: 在伦敦生命科学周上，生物医药高管和投资者表示由于多起数十亿美元的巨额并购和创纪录的风险投资基金，该行业**非常健康**。不过，业内人士警告称，美国即将对中国投资实施的**潜在限制**以及欧洲依然缺乏本土纳斯达克等问题，正持续影响着全球战略布局。
zh.full_summary:
在伦敦生命科学周期间，强生和礼来等制药巨头宣布了一系列大规模收购，其中包括强生22亿美元的交易以及礼来数额巨大的肿瘤和纤维化合作项目，使得重磅并购成为焦点。来自Baker McKenzie、Sofinnova Partners和Forbion的法律与金融专家指出，在Sofinnova筹集8.15亿美元和Forbion筹集23亿欧元等创纪录欧洲风投基金的支持下，**并购活动**预计将保持强劲势头。

尽管前景乐观，但仍面临重大逆风。投资者指出，欧洲依然缺乏**本土的纳斯达克替代市场**，这迫使成长中的生物医药公司只能将目光投向大西洋彼岸进行大规模公开上市。此外，中国自动化临床试验基础设施的迅速崛起已成为讨论的焦点，美国投资者正赶在美联储针对医药化合物对外投资的潜在监管收紧之前，抓紧敲定相关交易。

en.title: Quantus Launches a Quantum-Secure Cold Wallet That Runs on Any Spare Phone
en.summary: Quantus has released an **open-source mobile app** that turns any spare smartphone into an air-gapped, offline crypto wallet. The app stores keys inside the phone's **hardware security chip**, supports post-quantum digital signatures, and uses **QR-code transfers** to prevent online threats and physical tracking.
en.full_summary:
Quantus reports that it has launched the Quantus Cold Wallet to address hidden vulnerabilities in traditional hardware wallets, such as supply-chain tampering and physical home-address leaks tied to retail shipping. The app installs on any spare phone, and users permanently disable its Wi-Fi and mobile data during setup. According to Quantus CTO Nikolaus Heger, the software leverages the **secure elements** built into modern smartphones to keep keys safe and uses **plain-text transaction displays** to prevent blind signing. The wallet also features higher computing power than typical hardware wallets, allowing it to handle advanced cryptographic proofs, and it supports the ML-DSA post-quantum standard approved by NIST.

Quantus CEO Christopher Smith notes that the design helps users avoid the physical risks associated with specialized hardware wallets, which openly signal crypto ownership and expose buyers to targeted home-address leaks and related crimes. The app currently supports QTC, the native token of the Quantus network, and is available for download on the App Store and Google Play.

zh.title: Quantus推出可用闲置手机运行的量子安全冷钱包
zh.summary: Quantus发布了一款**开源手机应用**，能将任何闲置智能手机变成物理隔离的离线加密钱包。该应用将密钥保存在手机的**硬件安全芯片**中，支持抗量子数字签名，并通过**二维码传输**来防范网络威胁与实体追踪。
zh.full_summary:
据Quantus称，该公司已推出Quantus冷钱包，旨在解决传统硬件钱包中隐藏的漏洞，例如供应链篡改以及与零售配送相关的实体家庭住址泄漏。该应用可安装在任何闲置手机上，用户在设置时会永久禁用其Wi-Fi和移动数据。Quantus首席技术官Nikolaus Heger表示，该软件利用现代智能手机内置的**安全芯片**来保护密钥安全，并通过**明文交易显示**来防止盲签。此外，该钱包比典型硬件钱包拥有更强的计算能力，能够处理复杂的密码学证明，并支持美国国家标准与技术研究院批准的ML-DSA抗量子标准。

Quantus首席执行官Christopher Smith指出，这种设计有助于用户避开专用硬件钱包带来的实体风险，因为专用钱包会公开暗示数字资产所有权，从而使买家面临针对性的家庭地址泄漏及相关犯罪。该应用目前支持Quantus网络的原生代币QTC，现已在App Store和Google Play上架。

en.title: AI is evolving fast. Here is how Siemens plans to help data centers keep up
en.summary: According to Siemens Blog: AI technologies are developing rapidly, but building traditional data centers still takes years. Siemens executives at NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026 report that closing this gap requires **digital twin simulation**, modular construction, and closer collaboration between IT and power systems.
en.full_summary:
According to Siemens Blog:

At NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026, Siemens global solutions director Diego Witte and US data center head John DeBoer outlined the major hurdles facing AI infrastructure. While AI chips and compute demands scale rapidly, data centers face bottlenecks in scale, speed, skilled labor, and power availability.

To overcome these issues, Siemens advocates a shift toward **digital twin simulation** to test liquid cooling and rack configurations before physical construction. They also stress the need for standardized reference designs to align compute, power, and cooling ecosystems, and modular construction to combat labor shortages.

Furthermore, the report emphasizes that data centers must evolve into active grid participants. By combining software automation with physical hardware like battery storage and supercapacitors, and integrating IT with operational technology (OT), facilities can better manage extreme energy demands and improve overall efficiency.

zh.title: AI发展太快，西门子打算怎么帮数据中心跟上脚步？
zh.summary: 据Siemens Blog发布的信息：AI技术发展飞快，但建数据中心却得花好几年。西门子高管在NVIDIA GTC柏林2026大会上表示，想解决这个时间差，关键在于利用**数字孪生模拟**、模块化建造，以及让IT系统和电力网紧密配合。
zh.full_summary:
据Siemens Blog发布的信息：

在NVIDIA GTC柏林2026大会上，西门子全球数据中心解决方案总监迭戈·维特和美国数据中心业务负责人约翰·德波尔指出，AI基础设施正面临严峻挑战。虽然AI芯片和算力需求飞速增长，但数据中心在建设速度、专业人才和电力供应上却明显滞后。

为了解决这些难题，西门子提出了一套新打法：利用**数字孪生模拟**技术，在动工前先在虚拟世界里测试液冷系统和机架配置；通过标准化设计把计算、电力和冷却生态串联起来；并采用模块化施工来缓解技术工人短缺的问题。

此外，报告强调数据中心不能只顾着自己用电，还得变成电网的“好队友”。通过将软件自动化、电池储能和超级电容器等硬件结合，并把IT系统和运营技术（OT）打通，数据中心才能扛住巨大的能源压力，并在吉瓦级规模下实现更高效率。

en.title: Freiburg team secures about 10 million euros to explore commercial plastic volumetric 3D printing
en.summary: According to reports by Nanjixiong, researchers Bastian Rapp and Jürgen Rühe from the University of Freiburg have received about 10 million euros in **European Research Council synergy funding** for the CHiC2PRINT project. Over six years, the team will explore **volumetric 3D printing** using standard industrial plastics while integrating material recycling into the process design.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Funding
According to Nanjixiong, process technology professor Bastian Rapp and interface chemistry and physics professor Jürgen Rühe from the University of Freiburg have secured about 10 million euros in **European Research Council (ERC) synergy funding**. The funding will support the six-year CHiC2PRINT project, selected from over 950 applications.

## Technical Approach
The project aims to bridge the gap between commercially mature plastics and light-driven additive manufacturing. Instead of traditional layer-by-layer stacking, the team plans to use **directed light exposure** to form three-dimensional structures inside an existing volume of plastic. By combining process technology and interface chemistry, they aim to make standard plastics responsive to light control.

## Recycling and Outlook
CHiC2PRINT also incorporates product end-of-life handling into its design, aiming to separate formed objects through a process called **hierarchical dissociation** to recover and reuse raw plastics. The project intends to investigate whether commercial plastic systems can combine complex geometry manufacturing with efficient recycling, though specific recycling rates and production speeds are yet to be established.

zh.title: 获约1000万欧元项目资助，弗赖堡团队探索商用塑料体积式光固化3D打印可行性
zh.summary: 据南极熊报道，德国弗赖堡大学的Bastian Rapp与Jürgen Rühe获得欧洲研究理事会约1000万欧元的**协同项目资助**，将在六年内开展CHiC2PRINT项目。该团队将探索如何**利用普通工业塑料**进行体积式3D打印，并在工艺设计中同步考虑材料回收问题。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与资金支持
据南极熊报道，弗赖堡大学工艺技术教授巴斯蒂安·拉普与界面化学与物理教授于尔根·吕厄获得了欧洲研究理事会（ERC）大约1000万欧元的**协同项目资助**。这笔资金将支持为期六年的CHiC2PRINT项目，该项目是从950多份申请中脱颖而出的48个项目之一。

## 技术路线与目标
该项目旨在解决工业成熟塑料与光驱动增材制造之间的适配问题。与传统的逐层堆积不同，团队计划通过**定向光照**在已有塑料体内部直接形成三维结构。研究人员希望将加工方法和材料化学共同研究，使常见的工业塑料具备可受光控制的加工响应能力。

## 回收与后续展望
CHiC2PRINT还将产品报废后的处理纳入工艺设计，计划通过所谓的**分层解离**方式将成形物分离并回收利用。项目旨在探索商用塑料体系在实现复杂几何制造的同时是否也能兼顾循环回收，不过目前尚未公布具体的循环效率和生产速度数据。

en.title: ESA Awards OHB €102M Contract for ClearSpace-1 Debris Removal Mission
en.summary: The European Space Agency has awarded German satellite maker OHB a **€102 million contract** to build the ClearSpace-1 spacecraft, which will capture and remove the retired **Proba-1 satellite**. The mission has faced previous delays and redesigns after its original target was struck by debris, and is now scheduled to **launch in 2030**.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Restructuring
The European Space Agency signed the contract on 17 November at Space Tech Expo Europe in Bremen, marking the start of the implementation phase for ClearSpace-1. Originally awarded to a consortium led by Swiss startup ClearSpace in December 2020, the mission underwent major changes after its initial target was struck by space debris in August 2023. This forced a redesign, selecting Proba-1 as the new target and making OHB the **prime contractor**.

## Launch Details
The mission's launch plans have also shifted over time. While it was once slated for a Vega C rocket in 2026, technical papers and presentations point toward a dedicated microlauncher flight. An OHB presentation featured an illustration of the **RFA ONE rocket**, which is notable since OHB holds a majority stake in its developer, Rocket Factory Augsburg. However, neither ESA nor OHB has officially confirmed this launch vehicle, with the overall mission timeline now targeted for **2030**.

zh.title: 欧空局向德国 OHB 授出 1.02 亿欧元合同，推进 ClearSpace-1 太空垃圾清理任务
zh.summary: 欧洲空间局向德国卫星制造商 OHB 授予了一份价值 **1.02亿欧元** 的合同，用于建造 ClearSpace-1 航天器，以捕获并清除退役的 **Proba-1 卫星**。该任务此前因原定目标被太空 debris 撞击而经历过重新设计与延期，目前预计将于 **2030年发射**。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与项目重组
欧洲空间局于 11 月 17 日在德国不莱梅举行的欧洲太空技术博览会上签署了这项合同，标志着 ClearSpace-1 任务正式进入实施阶段。该项目最初于 2020 年 12 月授予瑞士初创公司 ClearSpace 领导的财团，但在 2023 年 8 月，其原定清理的目标被太空垃圾撞击，迫使项目进行重新设计，将目标更换为 Proba-1 卫星，并由 OHB 接任 **主承包商**。

## 发射安排与进展
该任务的发射计划也经历了多次调整。虽然最初计划于 2026 年使用织女星 C 型火箭发射，但相关技术文件和演示文稿显示，任务将改用专门的微型运载火箭。OHB 的演示文稿中曾出现 **RFA ONE 火箭** 的插图，这引人注目，因为 OHB 持有该火箭开发商 Rocket Factory Augsburg 的多数股权。不过，欧空局和 OHB 均未公开确认最终的运载火箭，目前整个任务的发射时间窗口已调整至 **2030年**。
